name: UCG-Max
title: Cloud Gateway Max
summary: Compact 5x2.5GbE cloud gateway + full UniFi OS console (Network/Protect/Access/Talk/Connect) with optional NVMe.

f.storage: 1x M.2 NVMe slot (optional SSD, up to 2TB)

extra.storage_note: No-Storage SKU ships without SSD and without the tray accessory needed for third-party NVMe

gotchas: No SFP/SFP+ port — fiber ONTs need a media converter; for a 10G SFP+ WAN look at UCG-Fiber.
IDS/IPS tops out at 2.3 Gbps, so a >2 Gbps plan is throttled with IPS enabled.
No PoE output — APs/cameras need a PoE switch (e.g. USW-Lite-8-PoE) or injectors.
'No Storage' SKU lacks both the NVMe SSD and the drive tray; Protect recording needs the 512GB/1–2TB SKU or the tray accessory.
Camera capacity is small (5x 4K / 15x HD) and 30-device ceiling — larger Protect sites need a UNVR/ENVR.
best_for: homes and small offices up to ~2 Gbps WAN
one box for gateway + a few cameras + Access
